subject.title: fix(proxy): bound managed proxy CA file reads

question: Should 256 KiB become the supported maximum size for existing proxy.tls.caFile CA bundles, or should the limit be widened before merge?
rationale: The patch intentionally converts a previously unrestricted documented CA-bundle setting into a fail-closed startup boundary, and repository history does not establish 256 KiB as the accepted compatibility contract.

options.title: Widen and document the boundary
options.body: Select a measured limit with enterprise-bundle headroom, document it, retain focused boundary tests, and add real HTTPS proxy proof.

options.title: Accept 256 KiB as the contract
options.body: Keep the proposed threshold but document the new maximum and provide fresh-install and upgrade-path evidence showing the intended failure behavior.

recommendation.title: Widen and document the boundary
recommendation.body: Select a measured limit with enterprise-bundle headroom, document it, retain focused boundary tests, and add real HTTPS proxy proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the final hardening and merged the original managed-proxy CA-trust surface, making them the strongest available owner for its compatibility boundary.
